title: Understanding MSE Minimization
text: To minimize the Mean Squared Error (MSE), consider how the error is calculated. The MSE is the average of the squares of the differences between the predicted values and the actual values. Think about how you can adjust $$\theta_0$$ to make these differences as small as possible.

title: Derivative Insight
text: When you take the derivative of a function, you're finding the rate at which the function's value changes. For MSE, taking the derivative with respect to $$\theta_0$$ helps you find the point where the error is minimized. What does it mean for the derivative to be zero?
